shared.tagline.en: Know the wait before you walk in.
shared.tagline.text: Xam waxtu xaar bi bala nga dugg.

shared.footer.copyright.en: © 2026 PickupRadar. Independent and not affiliated with Uber Eats, Deliveroo or Just Eat.
shared.footer.copyright.text: © 2026 PickupRadar. Moom boppam la, te amul lëkkaleek Uber Eats, Deliveroo walla Just Eat.

shared.scale.estimate.en: No recent reports? PickupRadar may show {likelyFast} or {likelySlow}:
shared.scale.estimate.text: Amul yëgle bu bees? PickupRadar mën na wone {likelyFast} walla {likelySlow}:

home.meta.title.en: PickupRadar (Pickup Radar): pickup wait times for delivery drivers in the UK
home.meta.title.text: PickupRadar (Pickup Radar): waxtu xaar bu jël ngir livrër yi ci Royaume-Uni

home.meta.description.en: See how long drivers wait at restaurants and shops before you go in. For Uber Eats, Deliveroo and Just Eat drivers in the UK. No sign-up needed.
home.meta.description.text: Xool livrër yi ñu ngi xaar lu ëpp ci restorã ak bitig yi bala nga dugg. Ngir livrër yi Uber Eats, Deliveroo ak Just Eat ci Royaume-Uni. Amul bindu.

home.meta.imageAlt.en: PickupRadar. Know the wait before you walk in.
home.meta.imageAlt.text: PickupRadar. Xam waxtu xaar bi bala nga dugg.

home.hero.lede.en: Do you deliver for Uber Eats, Deliveroo or Just Eat? See recent pickup waits at restaurants and shops. Avoid long waits. Tap {reportWait} and earn {radarPoints}. No sign-up needed.
home.hero.lede.text: Yaa ngi yónnee ngir Uber Eats, Deliveroo walla Just Eat? Xool waxtu xaar bu bees ci bérébu jël bu restorã ak bitig. Moytu xaar bu gudd. Bës {reportWait} te am {radarPoints}. Amul bindu.

home.hero.cities.en: Now in Milton Keynes. London is next.
home.hero.cities.text: Léegi ci Milton Keynes. Bi ci topp London.

home.hero.apps.en: The iPhone and Android apps are coming soon.
home.hero.apps.text: Aplikasyon iPhone ak Android dinañu ñëw léegi.

home.example.aria.en: Example PickupRadar Home screen with the {nearby} tab open, showing pickup points coloured by their wait
home.example.aria.text: Misaal bu ekran kër PickupRadar, tabil {nearby} ubbi na. Bérébu jël yi am nañu melo ci waxtu xaar

home.example.banner.en: Example screen: sample waits, not live driver reports
home.example.banner.text: Ekran misaal: waxtu xaar misaal la, du yëgle bu bees bu livrër

home.example.caption.en: Example screen. These are sample wait times, not live reports. {live} with real data.
home.example.caption.text: Ekran misaal. Waxtu xaar misaal la, du yëgle bu bees. {live} ci xibaar yu dëgg.

home.try.tab.en: {lead} Use {nearby} to find pickup points close to you when location is on. Use {fast} and {slow} to check waits and estimates.
home.try.tab.text: {lead} Jëfandikool {nearby} ngir gis bérébu jël yu jege na la bu bërëb ubbee. Jëfandikool {fast} ak {slow} ngir xool waxtu xaar ak natt.

home.try.search.en: {lead} Try a name, area or postcode, like KFC or Bletchley.
home.try.search.text: {lead} Jéem tur, gox walla koodu post, ni KFC walla Bletchley.

home.try.open.en: {lead} The {reportWait} screen opens. Choose a wait time. Nothing is sent.
home.try.open.text: {lead} Ekran {reportWait} ubbi. Tànnal waxtu xaar. Dara du yonnee.

home.signals.title.en: What you can see before you go in

home.signals.intro.en: You see the same labels in the app. Drivers report them, not the delivery apps.
home.signals.intro.text: Gis nga ni melokaan yi ci aplikasyon bi. Livrër yi yégle leen, du aplikasyon yónnee.

home.signals.current.body.en: Drivers choose a wait time. You see the current wait and how many drivers reported it in the last 2 hours.
home.signals.current.body.text: Livrër yi tànnal nañu waxtu xaar. Gis nga waxtu xaar bi léegi ak ñaata livrër yégle ko ci 2 waxtu yu mujj.

home.signals.likely.body.en: Shown only when there are no recent reports. These are estimates, not live reports.
home.signals.likely.body.text: Wonees na ko rekk su amul yëgle bu bees. Natt la, du yëgle bu bees.

home.signals.closed.body.en: Drivers tap {reportProblem} to report this. You see their report before you drive there.
home.signals.closed.body.text: Livrër yi bës {reportProblem} ngir yégle lii. Gis nga yëgle bi bala nga dem fa.

home.signals.missing.title.text: Bérébu jël bu ñàkk walla bu juum

home.how.intro.en: Three easy steps. Reporting takes a few seconds.
home.how.intro.text: Ñatti jàpp yu yomb. Yëgle bi jël na ay simili rekk.

home.how.step1.body.en: No password. The app gives you a Radar profile automatically. You don't need to sign up.
home.how.step1.body.text: Amul baat. Aplikasyon bi jox la profil Radar ci boppam. Waruloo bindu.

home.how.step2.body.en: Find the pickup point. See the current wait, or {likelyFast} or {likelySlow} if there are no recent reports.
home.how.step2.body.text: Seetal bérébu jël bi. Xool waxtu xaar bi léegi, walla {likelyFast} walla {likelySlow} su amul yëgle bu bees.

home.how.step3.body.en: After you collect the order, tap {reportWait}. It takes seconds. Your report helps other drivers, and you earn {radarPoints}.
home.how.step3.body.text: Bu nga jëlee ndën bi, bës {reportWait}. Ay simili rekk. Sa yëgle dimbali na livrër yi, te am nga {radarPoints}.

home.points.neededHelp.en: An eligible pickup point near you with no recent wait and no {likelyFast} or {likelySlow}. You earn 15 RP for the report instead of 10.
home.points.neededHelp.text: Bérébu jël bu jekk bu la jege, amul waxtu xaar bu bees, te amul {likelyFast} walla {likelySlow}. Am nga 15 RP ci yëgle boobu, du 10.

home.cities.body.en: These are the UK cities in the app. Can't find your city? Request it in the app. Or tap {notify} on a {comingSoon} city. We'll email you when it's live.
home.cities.body.text: Dëkk yu Royaume-Uni yi ci aplikasyon bi ñoo. Gisuloo sa dëkk? Laaj ko ci aplikasyon bi. Walla bës {notify} ci dëkk bu {comingSoon}. Danuy yónnee imeel bu mu beesee.

home.trust.title.en: Not part of any delivery app

home.trust.body.en: PickupRadar is independent. It is not part of Uber Eats, Deliveroo, Just Eat or any other delivery app. It never uses your accounts with them.
home.trust.body.text: PickupRadar moom boppam la. Du benn ci Uber Eats, Deliveroo, Just Eat walla beneen aplikasyon yónnee. Jëfandikoowul sa kont fa.

home.trust.login.en: {lead} We never ask for your Uber Eats, Deliveroo or Just Eat username or password.
home.trust.login.text: {lead} Laajunu tur walla baat Uber Eats, Deliveroo walla Just Eat.

home.trust.details.en: {lead} No names, addresses or order numbers.
home.trust.details.text: {lead} Amul tur, adres walla nimero ndën.

home.faq.account.a.en: No. The app gives you a Radar profile automatically. You can report waits straight away. To protect your {radarPoints}, add your email later. No password needed. The app emails you a 6-digit code.
home.faq.account.a.text: Déet. Aplikasyon bi jox la profil Radar ci boppam. Mën nga yégle waxtu xaar ci saa si. Ngir aar {radarPoints}, yokk imeel ci ginnaaw. Amul baat. Aplikasyon bi yónnee na kóodu 6 lim ci imeel.

home.faq.download.q.en: When can I download the app?
home.faq.download.q.text: Kaň laa mën a yeb aplikasyon bi?

home.faq.download.a.en: The iPhone and Android apps are coming soon. For now, the {preview} shows real Milton Keynes pickup points and waits.
home.faq.download.a.text: Aplikasyon iPhone ak Android dinañu ñëw léegi. Léegi, {preview} wone na bérébu jël yu dëgg ak waxtu xaar ci Milton Keynes.

home.faq.track.a.en: No background tracking. The app uses your location while you use it, to show nearby pickup points and check you are at a pickup point when reporting. The website asks for location only when you choose to use it. Read the {privacy} for more.
home.faq.track.a.text: Amul topp ci ginnaaw. Aplikasyon bi jëfandikoo sa bërëb bu nga koy jëfandikoo, ngir wone bérébu jël yu jege na la te seet ne yaa ngi ci bérébu jël bi bu ngay yégle. Dalu dal bi laaj bërëb rekk bu nga tànnee jëfandikoo ko. Jàng {privacy} ngir gëna xam.

app.meta.title.text: Xool bu bees bu aplikasyon — PickupRadar

app.meta.description.en: Try the PickupRadar app with real Milton Keynes data. Look around, search for pickup points and see the report screen.
app.meta.description.text: Jéem aplikasyon PickupRadar ci xibaar yu dëgg yu Milton Keynes. Xool ci wet, seetal bérébu jël te xool ekran yëgle.

app.hero.lede.en: This is PickupRadar with real Milton Keynes data. Look around. Search for a pickup point and open it. Nothing you tap here is sent. You can only report in the mobile app.
app.hero.lede.text: Lii PickupRadar la ci xibaar yu dëgg yu Milton Keynes. Xool ci wet. Seetal bérébu jël te ubbi ko. Lu nga bës fii du yonnee. Mën nga yégle rekk ci aplikasyon telefon.

app.preview.aria.en: Full PickupRadar app preview with real Milton Keynes data
app.preview.aria.text: Xool bu bees bu mat bu aplikasyon PickupRadar ci xibaar yu dëgg yu Milton Keynes

support.meta.description.en: Get help with PickupRadar: contact support, report a pickup point problem, and find answers about your Radar profile, {radarPoints} and deleting your account.
support.meta.description.text: Ndimbal PickupRadar: jokkoo ak ndimbal, yégle jafe-jafe bérébu jël, te gis tontu ci profil Radar, {radarPoints} ak far kont.

support.hero.lede.en: Need help? Email us about the app, a pickup point, your {radarPoints} or your privacy.
support.hero.lede.text: Soxla nga ndimbal? Yónnee imeel ci aplikasyon bi, bérébu jël, {radarPoints} walla sa sutura.

support.contact.body.en: Email us for help, ideas, pickup point problems or privacy questions:
support.contact.body.text: Yónnee imeel ngir ndimbal, xalaat, jafe-jafe bérébu jël walla laaj sutura:

support.address.note.en: For letters only. Email is the fastest way to reach us.
support.address.note.text: Ngir bataaxal rekk. Imeel moo gëna gaaw ngir jokkoo ak nun.

support.include.body.en: If you report a problem, please tell us:
support.include.body.text: Su ngay yégle jafe-jafe, wax nu:

support.include.area.en: The area or postcode, if you know it
support.include.area.text: Gox walla koodu post, su nga ko xam

support.include.phone.en: Your phone model, if the app has a problem
support.include.phone.text: Melokaan telefon, su jafe-jafe bi nekkee ci aplikasyon bi

support.topics.profile.body.en: The app gives you a Radar profile automatically. You do not need to log in to use PickupRadar or earn {radarPoints}. Adding your email is optional. It protects your {radarPoints} if you change or reset your phone. No password needed. The app emails you a 6-digit code.
support.topics.profile.body.text: Aplikasyon bi jox la profil Radar ci boppam. Waruloo dugg ngir jëfandikoo PickupRadar walla am {radarPoints}. Yokk imeel du lu war. Mu aar {radarPoints} su nga soppee walla delloo telefon bi. Amul baat. Aplikasyon bi yónnee na kóodu 6 lim ci imeel.

support.topics.points.body.en: You earn {radarPoints} for valid wait reports ({waitRp}, or {neededRp} when it says {reportNeeded}), a first report bonus ({firstRp}) and pickup points we approve ({approvedRp}). You can invite a driver from {profile}. You both need protected Radar accounts (add your email). Your friend enters your code before their first valid wait report. When your friend makes 3 valid wait reports, on at least 2 different days (UTC time), at 2 different pickup points, you each earn {referralRp}. {rewards} You can't redeem {radarPoints} yet.
support.topics.points.body.text: Am nga {radarPoints} ci yëgle bu baax bu waxtu xaar ({waitRp}, walla {neededRp} bu ñu bind {reportNeeded}), yool yëgle bu jëkk ({firstRp}) ak bérébu jël bu nu nangu ({approvedRp}). Mën nga woo livrër ci {profile}. Yéen ñaar soxla ngeen kontu Radar bu ñu aar (yokk imeel). Sa xarit dugal sa kóod bala yëgle bu jëkk bu baax bu waxtu xaar. Bu sa xarit defee 3 yëgle yu baax yu waxtu xaar, ci lu néew 2 fan yu wuute (waxtu UTC), ci 2 bérébu jël yu wuute, ku nekk am {referralRp}. {rewards} Mënoo jëfandikoo {radarPoints} léegi.

support.topics.messages.body.en: {profile} has {messages}: announcements, alerts and personal messages for your city or Radar profile. Old or removed messages may no longer appear.
support.topics.messages.body.text: {profile} am na {messages}: yëgle, artu ak bataaxal bu bopp ngir sa dëkk walla sa profil Radar. Bataaxal yu mag walla yu ñu dindi mën nañu bañ feeñaat.

support.topics.delete.body.en: Delete your account in the app: {profile} → {deleteAccount}. Or email {email}. If you did not add an email, the app shows {deleteProfile} instead. See the {page} page for the steps.
support.topics.delete.body.text: Far kont bi ci aplikasyon bi: {profile} → {deleteAccount}. Walla yónnee imeel ci {email}. Su yokkul imeel, aplikasyon bi wone {deleteProfile}. Xool xët {page} ngir jàpp yi.

support.topics.missing.body.en: Is a pickup point missing? Tap {suggest} in the app. Is one wrong? Tap {reportProblem}. Or email us and we will check it.
support.topics.missing.body.text: Bérébu jël bi amul? Bës {suggest} ci aplikasyon bi. Am na lu juum? Bës {reportProblem}. Walla yónnee imeel, danuy xool.

support.topics.delivery.body.en: PickupRadar does not connect to your Uber Eats, Deliveroo, Just Eat or other delivery app accounts. We never ask for your delivery app logins, passwords, account details, customer details or order details. Drivers only share pickup reports, like wait times and pickup point problems.
support.topics.delivery.body.text: PickupRadar lëkkaleewul ak sa kont Uber Eats, Deliveroo, Just Eat walla beneen aplikasyon yónnee. Laajunu dugg, baat, xibaar kont, xibaar kiliyaan walla xibaar ndën. Livrër yi séddoo yëgle jël rekk, ni waxtu xaar ak jafe-jafe bérébu jël.

support.closer.title.en: Try PickupRadar before the app launches.
support.closer.title.text: Jéem PickupRadar bala aplikasyon bi génn.

support.closer.body.en: The live preview shows real Milton Keynes pickup points and waits. Reporting and {radarPoints} are only in the mobile app.
support.closer.body.text: Xool bu bees wone na bérébu jël yu dëgg ak waxtu xaar ci Milton Keynes. Yëgle ak {radarPoints} ci aplikasyon telefon rekk lañu nekk.

notfound.meta.description.en: That page is not on the PickupRadar website.
notfound.meta.description.text: Xët boobu nekkul ci dalu dal PickupRadar.

notfound.title.en: This page is off the radar.
notfound.title.text: Xët bii ci biti radar la.

notfound.body.en: That address isn't on the PickupRadar website. These pages are:
notfound.body.text: Adres boobu nekkul ci dalu dal PickupRadar. Xët yii am nañu:

privacy.toc.aria.text: Xaaj yi ci pólitig sutura bi

privacy.notice.en: The summary and section headings are translated. The full privacy policy is in English, which is the official version.
privacy.notice.text: Ñu tekki nañu ndajem gi ak bopp xaaj yi. Pólitig sutura bi mépp mu ngi ci àngale, te sumb bu àngale moo nekk sumb bu dëggu bi.

privacy.h.collect.en: Information we collect and how we use it
privacy.h.collect.text: Xibaar yi nuy dajale ak ni nu leen di jëfandikoo

privacy.h.transfers.text: Yónnee xibaar ci réew yu wuute

privacy.h.retention.text: Lu tollu ban diir lanuy denc xibaar

privacy.sum.what.en: PickupRadar helps delivery drivers see and report pickup wait times and venue problems.
privacy.sum.what.text: PickupRadar dafay dimbali dawalkat yuy jëfandikoo yobbu, ñu gis te yégle diirub xaar ci jël kómaand yi ak jafe-jafe yi ci bérab yi.

privacy.sum.account.en: You can browse without creating an account. The app creates an anonymous Radar profile for your phone, and an email account is optional.
privacy.sum.account.text: Mën nga seetlu te amoo kontu. Aplikasioŋ bi dafay sos ab porofil Radar bu amul tur ngir sa telefon, te kontu email day nekk ci sa coobare.

privacy.sum.location.en: If you allow location, the app uses it while you are using it: to sort nearby pickup points, detect your city and check that you are at a venue when you submit a live report. We do not save your location with your reports.
privacy.sum.location.text: Bu nga may bérab, aplikasioŋ bi dafay ko jëfandikoo rekk bi ngay jëfandikoo aplikasioŋ bi: ngir toftal bérabi jël yi jege, xam sa dëkk, te seet ne nga ngi ci bérab bi bi ngay yónnee yégle bu leegi leegi. Dunu denc sa bérab ak say yégle.

privacy.sum.saved.en: Your saved pickup points stay on your phone.
privacy.sum.saved.text: Bérabi jël yi nga denc ñu ngi des ci sa telefon.

privacy.sum.noSale.en: We do not sell your personal information and the app contains no advertising or analytics trackers.
privacy.sum.noSale.text: Dunu jaay sa xibaar yu sa bopp, te aplikasioŋ bi amul benn toppkat bu kaaraange walla bu xool-xool.

privacy.sum.delete.en: You can delete your Radar profile or account in the app, or ask us by email. See {link}.
privacy.sum.delete.text: Mën nga far sa porofil Radar walla sa kontu ci aplikasioŋ bi, walla nga laaj nu ko ci email. Xoolal {link}.

delete.meta.title.en: Delete your account or data — PickupRadar
delete.meta.title.text: Far sa kontu walla say xibaar — PickupRadar

delete.meta.description.en: How to delete your PickupRadar account, Radar profile and associated data, including without the app.
delete.meta.description.text: Ni ngay fare sa kontu PickupRadar, sa porofil Radar ak xibaar yi ci aju, su fekkee amoo aplikasioŋ bi sax.

delete.h1.text: Far sa kontu walla say xibaar

delete.lead.en: This page explains how to delete your PickupRadar account, your Radar profile and the data linked to them, including if you no longer have the app. PickupRadar is developed by Hamza Khan.
delete.lead.text: Xët wii dafay leeral ni ngay fare sa kontu PickupRadar, sa porofil Radar ak xibaar yi ci aju, su fekkee amatoo aplikasioŋ bi sax. Hamza Khan moo defar PickupRadar.

delete.app.title.text: Far ko ci aplikasioŋ bi (moo gën a gaaw)

delete.app.step2.en: Tap {profile} at the bottom of the Home screen.
delete.app.step2.text: Bësal {profile} ci suufu ekraŋ bu njëkk bi.

delete.app.step3.en: Scroll down and tap {deleteAccount} if you protected your RadarPoints with your email, or {deleteProfile} if you did not.
delete.app.step3.text: Wàcc ci suuf te bësal {deleteAccount} bu fekkee aar nga sa RadarPoints ak email, walla {deleteProfile} bu dul noonu.

delete.app.after.en: Deletion starts straight away. Afterwards, the app starts a new anonymous Radar profile on your phone.
delete.app.after.text: Fare gi dafay tàmbali ci saa si. Ginnaaw loolu aplikasioŋ bi dafay tàmbali porofil Radar bu bees bu amul tur ci sa telefon.

delete.email.title.en: Ask us to delete your email account
delete.email.title.text: Laaj nu nu far sa kontu email

delete.email.intro.en: If you protected your RadarPoints with your email address and cannot use the app:
delete.email.intro.text: Bu fekkee aar nga sa RadarPoints ak adrees email te mënoo jëfandikoo aplikasioŋ bi:

delete.email.step1.text: Yónneel email ci {email} {from}, ak tur bii: “{subject}”.

delete.email.from.en: from the email address on your PickupRadar account
delete.email.from.text: jóge ci adrees email bi ci sa kontu PickupRadar

delete.email.step2.en: We will reply to that address to confirm the request before deleting anything.
delete.email.step2.text: Dinanu tontu ci adrees boobu ngir dëggal laaj bi balaa nuy far dara.

delete.email.other.en: If you write from a different address, we will need to confirm that you control the account’s email address. We will never ask for a password or for a sign-in code. Do not send us your code.
delete.email.other.text: Bu nga bindee jóge ci beneen adrees, war nanu dëggal ne yaa yor adrees email bu kontu bi. Dunu la mukk laaj baatu jàll walla kodu duggu. Bul nu yónnee sa kod.

delete.anon.p1.en: If you never added an email address, your Radar profile is linked only to a random ID stored in the app on your phone. The easiest way to delete it is in the app, using the steps above.
delete.anon.p1.text: Bu fekkee mukk yokkuloo adrees email, sa porofil Radar dafa lëkkaloo rekk ak ab ID bu ñu tànn ci ndaw-ndaw bu ñu denc ci aplikasioŋ bi ci sa telefon. Yoon wi gën a yomb ngir far ko mooy ci aplikasioŋ bi, ak tànki kaw yi.

delete.anon.p2.en: Deleting the app removes that ID from your phone, but it does {not} delete the records on our servers.
delete.anon.p2.text: Fare aplikasioŋ bi dafay dindi ID boobu ci sa telefon, waaye {not} denc yi ci sunu serwëër yi.

delete.anon.p3.en: Ownership of an anonymous profile can only be proven from the phone it was created on, using the random ID and secret code stored in the app. Details such as a Radar name, a city or the dates you used the app can’t prove that a profile is yours, because other people could know them. So if you no longer have the app, we may not be able to delete an anonymous profile. You can still email {email} and we will explain what we can do.
delete.anon.p3.text: Moomeel porofil bu amul tur mën nañu ko dëggal rekk jóge ci telefon bi ñu ko sosee, ak ID bu ñu tànn ci ndaw-ndaw ak kod bu kumpa bu ñu denc ci aplikasioŋ bi. Xibaar yu mel ni turu Radar, dëkk walla bis yi nga jëfandikoo aplikasioŋ bi du wone ne porofil bi yaa ko moom, ndaxte ñeneen mën nañu ko xam itam. Moo tax bu fekkee amatoo aplikasioŋ bi, man na am ne dunu mën a far porofil bu amul tur. Waaye mën nga yónnee email ci {email} te dinanu la leeral li nu mën a def.

delete.alerts.title.text: Email yu yégle tàmbali ci dëkk yi

delete.alerts.body.en: You can withdraw a launch alert in the app, or email us from the address you signed up with and we will delete the sign-ups for that address. Launch-alert emails are also deleted automatically, as explained in our {privacy}.
delete.alerts.body.text: Mën nga dindi yégleb tàmbali ci aplikasioŋ bi, walla nga yónnee nu email jóge ci adrees bi nga bindoo te dinanu far bind yu adrees boobu. Email yu yégleb tàmbali ñu ngi leen di far itam ci seen bopp, ni ko sunu {privacy} di leeralee.

delete.deleted.profile.en: Your Radar profile, Radar name, RadarPoints and contribution history
delete.deleted.profile.text: Sa porofil Radar, turu Radar, RadarPoints ak sa jaar-jaaru njàppale

delete.deleted.email.en: Your email sign-in, if you had an email account
delete.deleted.email.text: Sa duggu ak email, bu fekkee am nga kontu email

delete.deleted.links.en: The links between your phone’s device ID and your profile
delete.deleted.links.text: Lëkkalé yi ci diggante ID bu jumtukaayu sa telefon ak sa porofil

delete.deleted.referrals.en: Your referral codes, and your read or dismissed status for in-app messages
delete.deleted.referrals.text: Say kodu woote, ak ndax bataaxali aplikasioŋ bi jàng nañu leen walla tëj nañu leen

delete.deleted.alerts.en: City launch alert sign-ups linked to your profile or phone
delete.deleted.alerts.text: Bind yu yégleb tàmbali yu lëkkaloo ak sa porofil walla sa telefon

delete.deleted.notes.en: Notes on the problem reports, status reports and venue suggestions linked to your profile
delete.deleted.notes.text: Bind yi ci yégle jafe-jafe yi, yégle ci anam yi ak xelal bérab yi yu lëkkaloo ak sa porofil

delete.kept.reports.en: {lead}, such as wait times, venue status reports and tags, and venue suggestions: the device ID on the records linked to your profile is replaced with a random value, so they are no longer connected to your profile in our database. They still contain details such as the venue and time, so they are de-identified rather than fully anonymous. They may be kept so they can still help other drivers.
delete.kept.reports.text: {lead}, ni diirub xaar, yégle ci anamu bérab yi ak màndarga yi, ak xelal bérab: ID bu jumtukaay bi ci denc yi lëkkaloo ak sa porofil dañu koy wecciku ak ab njëg bu ñu tànn ci ndaw-ndaw, kon ci sunu dencukaayu xibaar lëkkalootuñu ak sa porofil. Ñu ngi am ba leegi xibaar yu mel ni bérab ak waxtu, kon dindi nañu ci li may xam nit ki, waaye du lu amul tur lépp. Mën nañu leen denc ngir ñu wéy di dimbali yeneen dawalkat.

delete.kept.referrals.en: {lead} that involved you, without your profile.
delete.kept.referrals.text: {lead} yi nga bokk, te sa porofil nekku ci.

delete.kept.receipt.en: {lead} for email accounts (an internal account reference, the device ID, a one-way scrambled copy of the phone’s secret code and dates), so the deletion can be completed safely and shown to have happened.
delete.kept.receipt.text: {lead} ngir kontu email yi (jokkoo bu biir bu kontu bi, ID bu jumtukaay bi, ab kopi bu ñu kumpa ci benn yoon bu kod bu kumpa bu telefon bi, ak bis yi), ngir fare gi mën a jeex ci kaaraange te ñu mën a wone ne am na.

delete.kept.receiptLead.text: Ab dencu fare bu gën a tuuti

delete.kept.backups.en: {lead}: our database provider keeps daily backups for 7 days, so deleted information can stay in a backup for up to 7 days.
delete.kept.backups.text: {lead}: kiy may sunu dencukaayu xibaar dafay denc kopi yu bés bu nekk 7 fan, kon xibaar yi ñu far mën nañu des ci ab kopi ba 7 fan.

delete.kept.support.en: {lead} about your request, for as long as we need them to deal with it.
delete.kept.support.text: {lead} ci sa laaj, lu tollu ni ko soxla ngir saytu ko.

delete.kept.more.en: See our {privacy} for full details of how long we keep information and your other rights.
delete.kept.more.text: Ngir xam lépp ci lu tollu ban diir lanuy denc xibaar ak say yeneen sañ-sañ, xoolal sunu {privacy}.
